annotation_logic: HARD rule (no distance gate): cluster refs -> LCA of refs inside cluster; ref-less cluster -> LCA under first ancestor with refs (common ancestor one level up); singleton -> nearest ancestor with refs (never borrows reference strains of other clusters); ancestor-based annotations accepted at their own rank regardless of ASV-to-ancestor distance (d>0.03 or d<0.03); HOMD relation computed AFTER annotation
